_comment: Fingerprint registry — every theme records the design choices that distinguish it from siblings. Phase A2e of /new-theme reads this file to pick a NEW fingerprint; Phase 11 appends the new theme. The uniqueness check (tools/check-theme-uniqueness.mjs) blocks a ship when the new theme's (archetype + signatureConcept + signatureMove + homepageSections) collides with any existing entry. Backfilled 2026-05-25 from the existing 7 themes — best-effort entries based on the actual on-disk components and the inventory-design-library rotation table.

schema.themeId: kebab-case theme folder name under app/themes/
schema.archetype: classic | classic-trad | classic-warm | modern | minimalist | industrial | editorial | rugged | luxury | prestige
schema.signatureConcept: 1-sentence design concept that locks the theme's distinctive direction
schema.signatureMove: kebab-case identifier from the Signature Move menu (SKILL §Distinctiveness contract)
schema.personalityVoice: formal | warm | technical | editorial | playful | brutalist | utilitarian
schema.headerStructure: kebab-case from the Header menu (topbar-strip-plus-horizontal-nav | thin-sticky-transparent | dark-stat-pills | tall-symmetrical | two-tier-editorial | vertical-side-rail | etc.)
schema.heroPattern: kebab-case from the Hero menu (centered-headline | split-screen | dark-fullbleed | corner-serif-display | mixed-media-asymmetric | typography-only | etc.)
schema.homepageSections: array of kebab-case section ids (hero | trust | latest-arrivals | service-highlights | services | cta | reviews | directory | specs-bar | recently-sold-preview | editorial-intro | featured-collection | acquisitions | edition-strip | pull-quote | stats-band | location-feature | founder-note | etc.)
schema.inventoryListPattern: kebab-case from inventory-design-library (showroom-grid | filtered-sidebar | compact-list | map-overlay | editorial-spotlight | stacked-cards | carousel-per-make | etc.)
schema.vehicleDetailPattern: kebab-case from inventory-design-library (gallery-forward | spec-sheet-vertical | magazine-editorial | configurator-led | comparison-view | story-driven | full-bleed-mosaic | etc.)
schema.oneBigMove: none | typography-scale | gradient-coverage | decorative-density | brand-color-coverage — the ONE restraint axis this theme is allowed to exceed
